# 8 Best Patreon Alternatives for Creators in 2026 (Compared)

 March 17, 2026 · 11 min read 

Patreon changed the creator economy when it launched in 2013. For the first time, fans could directly support the artists, musicians, podcasters, and developers they loved through recurring monthly pledges. But in 2026, a growing number of creators are looking for alternatives.

The reasons are real: platform fees between 5% and 12%, payment processing on top of that, restrictive content policies, delayed payouts, and zero support for cryptocurrency. If you have been thinking about leaving Patreon or diversifying beyond it, this guide compares 8 alternatives with honest pros and cons for each.

## Why Creators Leave Patreon

Before diving into alternatives, it helps to understand the specific frustrations driving creators away from Patreon. These are not minor inconveniences — they directly affect creator income and creative freedom.

### Fees That Eat Into Your Income

Patreon charges a platform fee on every dollar you earn. The exact rate depends on your plan:

- Patreon Lite: 5% platform fee + payment processing (2.9% + $0.30 per transaction)
- Patreon Pro: 8% platform fee + payment processing
- Patreon Premium: 12% platform fee + payment processing
